tool_input.content:
version: 2
models:
  - name: can_portfolio
    description: "Canonical portfolio view. One row per financial account enriched with model portfolio details, latest month returns and benchmark comparison, and aggregated holdings summary. Joins can_account_value with res_model_portfolio, res_return_record, and res_position."
    config:
      domain: 'Account'
    columns:
      - name: portfolio_id
        description: "Surrogate key for this canonical row"
        tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: financial_account_id
        description: "FSC financial account identifier"
        tests: [unique, not_null]
      - name: account_number
        description: "Custodian-assigned account number"
      - name: account_name
        description: "Resolved account display name"
      - name: market_value
        description: "Resolved total market value"
      - name: is_discretionary
        description: "Whether the account has discretionary authority"
      - name: client_id
        description: "FSC account ID representing the client"
      - name: client_name
        description: "Client full name"
      - name: client_segment
        description: "Client segment: HNW, UHNW, Mass Affluent, Institutional"
      - name: advisor_id
        description: "Primary advisor identifier"
      - name: advisor_name
        description: "Primary advisor name"
      - name: model_id
        description: "Assigned model portfolio ID"
      - name: model_name
        description: "Model portfolio display name"
      - name: risk_profile
        description: "Model risk profile: Conservative, Moderate, Growth, Aggressive"
      - name: equity_target_pct
        description: "Model target equity allocation percentage"
      - name: fixed_income_target_pct
        description: "Model target fixed income allocation percentage"
      - name: alternative_target_pct
        description: "Model target alternative allocation percentage"
      - name: cash_target_pct
        description: "Model target cash allocation percentage"
      - name: return_as_of_date
        description: "Date of the latest return record"
      - name: mtd_return
        description: "Month-to-date portfolio return"
      - name: qtd_return
        description: "Quarter-to-date portfolio return"
      - name: ytd_return
        description: "Year-to-date portfolio return"
      - name: itd_return
        description: "Inception-to-date portfolio return"
      - name: one_year_return
        description: "Trailing 1-year portfolio return"
      - name: three_year_return
        description: "Trailing 3-year annualized portfolio return"
      - name: five_year_return
        description: "Trailing 5-year annualized portfolio return"
      - name: benchmark_name
        description: "Benchmark used for comparison"
      - name: mtd_excess_return
        description: "MTD return minus benchmark MTD return"
      - name: ytd_excess_return
        description: "YTD return minus benchmark YTD return"
      - name: one_year_excess_return
        description: "1-year return minus benchmark 1-year return"
      - name: holding_count
        description: "Number of distinct securities held"
      - name: holdings_market_value
        description: "Sum of position market values"
      - name: holdings_cost_basis
        description: "Sum of position cost basis"
      - name: total_unrealized_gain_loss
        description: "Sum of unrealized gain/loss across all positions"
      - name: positions_as_of_date
        description: "Latest date of position data"
